title: Verifier + acceptance gate
description:
## Intent

As a publication operator, I want a verifier that assesses an explicitly applied working draft, so I can decide whether it improved before human approval.

## Done when

- It highlights factual changes, deleted claims, duplicated ideas, and residual boilerplate after an explicit human apply.
- It computes a transparent weighted score for specificity, clarity, audience fit, and voice match, minus redundancy, unsupported claims, and factual-change risk.
- Its recommendation is advisory: accept only when net improvement reaches the configured threshold and unsupported claims do not increase.
- Detector scores are not an input, and verification never applies or publishes changes.

## Gherkin

Feature: Verify a human-steered revision
  Scenario: Recommend an improved revision
    Given an original draft and an explicitly applied working draft
    When an operator runs verification with local style rules
    Then Limatus reports quality dimensions and evidence-backed findings
    And it recommends acceptance only when the threshold is met and unsupported claims have not increased
    And neither draft is changed

  Scenario: Reject a riskier revision
    Given a working draft with a new unsupported claim or a factual-change risk
    When an operator runs verification
    Then Limatus advises against acceptance
    And it does not publish or modify either draft

## Out of scope

Auto-applying a revision, auto-publishing, or any detector-score optimization.

Migrated from PPY-5ca22f.
